description: Intelligent brainstorming facilitator that guides ideation from vague concepts to structured deliverables. Conducts iterative exploration with Socratic questioning, framework application, and Perplexity-powered research. Features EMS (Exploration Maturity Score) for real-time progress tracking, adaptive personas, and explicit divergent/convergent phases. Generates optimized Perplexity prompts for web enrichment, then synthesizes results into exploration. Use when user says "brainstorm", "let's explore", "I have an idea", "help me think through", or needs structured ideation on features, projects, audits, decisions, problems, or strategy. Not for simple Q&A, direct task execution, or when user already has clear specifications.
